subheadline: Five modules come with one licence. These four come up in every tender, listed in the order most evaluations check them.

items.title: Vertex Dispatch
items.content: Scheduling, routing and SLA tracking for the whole crew. Recurring contracts create their own jobs, so planned work and breakdowns share one calendar.

items.title: Vertex Field
items.content: The technician app. Job sheets, checklists, photos and signatures work offline for seven days. The customer gets a PDF copy as soon as the device reconnects.

items.title: Vertex Assets
items.content: One register for every chiller, lift and air handler you maintain. Serial numbers, warranty dates and service history open from a QR label on the unit.

items.title: Vertex Insights
items.content: Contract profit, first-time fix rate and travel time per technician, exported weekly. Halden Facilities uses it to decide which contracts to reprice.
